crossRefs.note: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.
My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He…
I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed without being…
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

translations.web: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
translations.bsb: They are smashed to pieces from dawn to dusk; unnoticed, they perish forever.
translations.kjv: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding
translations.asv: Betwixt morning and evening they are destroyed: They perish for ever without any regarding it.
